results.title: Secure File Uploads and Downloads in S3 Using Presigned URLs
results.snippet: A presigned URL is an URL that grants temporary access to a specific object in an S3 bucket. It is generated for a specific object key within a specific S3 bucket, with an expiration time and a specified HTTP method (Get or Put). Requirements for Generating Presigned URLs.
